notes: Implementation limitations first: (1) when IMD is the specified currency (exact-input buys, exact-output sells) and the swap fills only partly (price limit or liquidity exhausted), the unowed part of the fee declared in beforeSwap is refunded from the PoolManager's IMD balance; if the manager holds too little IMD (e.g. the launch pool before its first buy settles) that swap reverts with ShortFillNotRefundable rather than being overcharged. Full fills never need a refund and are not affected. (2) Fee delivery is deferred when the PoolManager holds less IMD than the fee or the transfer to the recipient fails: the hook mints itself an ERC-6909 IMD claim, redeemed to the fixed recipient by a later swap that can deliver it or by anyone calling collectPending(); the swap itself still succeeds. RNNNToken is the rnnn.io community token RNNN for the RNNN/IMD Uniswap v4 pool on Robinhood Chain (4663); its constructor takes no arguments. RNNNImdFeeHook constructor order is poolManager_ ("$poolManager"), imd_ (IMD, 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127), feeRecipient_ (0x45c89d0cf0b8a05218506236fcfcb18da1d3ebe4); all immutable. It has no owner, pause, setters, token minting or upgrade path, and no fee other than its one rule. The hook fee is 1% (100 bps, floor) of the IMD the pool actually traded, read from the pool's BalanceDelta in afterSwap on every swap shape, separate from the pool's 12500 (1.25%) LP fee. When IMD is unspecified (exact-output buys, exact-input sells) it is charged via afterSwapReturnDelta; when IMD is specified, beforeSwap declares the full-fill fee (X/101 of an exact input, Y/99 of an exact output) via beforeSwapReturnDelta and afterSwap trues it up to the fill. The fee is taken and paid only in IMD; it is never swapped to ETH or any other token, and the recipient never receives RNNN. Enabled callbacks and unlockCallback accept only the configured PoolManager. beforeInitialize returns its selector for any pool with an IMD side from any initializer (the launch factory included), so it accepts fee 12500 and tick spacing 60; it does not restrict the initializer, LP fee or spacing. Unused callbacks revert. The declared permissions match getHookPermissions and address bits 0x20cc. pool.initialPrice records the reference value; the deployer derives the actual opening price under the separately versioned launch policy. Foundry tests cover exact-input and exact-output buys and sells paying exactly 1% of the IMD side to the recipient, partial-fill refunds, deferred claims and collection, a blocked recipient, permission bits, initialization, and absence of privileged functions.
